rationale: VERSION 3.3.0 -> 3.4.0: replaced the unordered morphology prior with five linked profiles that retain component reading order, legend-role assignment, and each component's D4 shape class.; Added linked_profile_signature, is_canonical_linked_profile, selected_shape_signature, and rule_mirror so the semantic predicate and independent parity checks are executable.; Profile construction varies color labels, placement, gaps, and component orientation while preserving the linked role/order/shape-class facts that drive last-piece selection and output packing.; General duplicate-color components are now shape-distinguishable; placement retries prevent a fallback from silently collapsing two same-color pieces to the same shape.; self_check now enforces 1..5 legend colors, at most two duplicates and two distractors, and legend order different from below reading order for multi-color grids.; Strict call validation rejects unknown controls, invalid difficulty, invalid enums, bool-as-int, and non-integer numeric axes instead of coercing or ignoring them.; Explicit texture='none' is byte-identical to omission; palette texture aliases are executed and recorded; every forced degenerate records texture, dimensions, counts, and palette provenance.; Expanded the declared n_colors boundary to 1..5 so the lawful one_color texture is inside the contract.; Added focused tests for all five public pairs, main/disjoint linked coverage, exact provenance, checker mutations, strict controls, duplicate disambiguation, lawful negative recombination, fresh returns, determinism, and process-global RNG isolation.
summary: Read the distinct nonzero colors in row 0 from left to right as the output order. Row 1 is an empty separator. In rows 2 onward, find the 4-connected pieces; for each legend color select its last piece in component reading order, tightly crop it while preserving internal zeros, and pack the selected crops top-aligned in legend order with one zero column between them. Same-color earlier pieces are decoys and non-legend pieces are ignored.
